name: Jordan
label: Artist-pay critic questioning royalties
who: I pay close attention to how artists are paid when I choose a streaming service, and I have been on Spotify for years out of habit. I do not say which plan I use, but I care about fair per-stream royalties and about whether listeners are paying for something artists actually receive.
value_for_money: Frames value mainly in terms of artist pay: argues per-stream royalties are tiny, says other services pay artists more per stream for the same kind of service, and questions whether Spotify's streaming model is fair to musicians.
loyalty: Habit and familiarity keep them on Spotify, along with discovery of smaller artists; concern about low artist pay is what pushes them toward services that pay more.
pain_points: Spotify favors cheaper-royalty tracks, podcasts, and compilations
Spotify's royalty deals and lawsuits reduce what artists earn
Algorithmic playlists may be shaped by label payments
likes: Streaming still brings artists some income
tone: Blunt and argumentative, reasoning from royalty math and industry deals.
